system.description:
Fire leaps and spits sparks at the sorcerer’s call. Anyone sitting around the targeted fire suffers. Must be cast into a fire source. Will douse torches when cast, but will not unduly affect campfires or larger blazes. Damaging effect spell: Base Power = ½ Will +3, VA 2. Die of Fate to determine IMS. Weapon Length: as Polearm; Range: as Pistol.

Obstacle: 2^. Actions: 1.

Origin: Presence | Area of Effect: Single Target | Element: Fire | Impetus: Destroy | Duration: Instantaneous | Resource Points: 8

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 219
